verdict.rationale: Daily's dedicated dial-in/dial-out guide documents both directions of the telephony bridge. Callers can dial in over PSTN using global numbers in 27 countries, with webhook routing so no PIN is needed. Developers can dial out from a room to PSTN numbers, SIP callers are supported, DTMF works in both directions, and compatibility is tested with Twilio, Telnyx, SignalWire and SIP hardware phones. missing for 10: independent hands-on or community corroboration of the SIP/PSTN bridging, explicit SIP dial-out documentation detail.

support.subject: As a developer, phone callers join a session through documented SIP or PSTN dial-in and dial-out

citations.quote: Let participants join or be called via a regular phone number.
Daily provides global dial-in numbers in 27 countries.
incoming calls trigger a webhook where you can define logic to route the call to a Daily room without requiring a PIN.
Dial out to a mobile or PSTN phone number from within a Daily room
Daily can receive DTMF from a PSTN or SIP caller and deliver it to the room.
Tested with CPaaS vendors (Twilio, Telnyx, SignalWire) and SIP hardware phones (Poly, Cisco).
